story: Full compliance assessment of Entity-A against REG-100 (Data Protection). The agent must get regulation details, assess compliance status (score 45% — non-compliant), check violation history (2 prior violations), get remediation steps for documentation gaps, file a compliance report, and notify the compliance officer with critical severity since the score is below 50%.

args.findings: Score 45%. Gaps: REQ-100-A (incomplete processing records), REQ-100-B (no breach notification), REQ-100-C (no DPIA in 18 months), REQ-100-E (DSAR over 30 days). 2 prior violations including unresolved VIO-102.
args.remediation_plan: Documentation audit and completion (15 weeks), breach notification process (6 weeks), schedule DPIA immediately.

args.message: Entity-A compliance score 45% for REG-100 (Data Protection). 3 failed requirements, 1 partial. 2 prior violations including unresolved VIO-102. Immediate remediation required.

starting_sentence: Assess Entity-A's compliance with REG-100 — full assessment, check history, remediate gaps, file report
